WITH
  cohorts AS
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     min(event_date) AS first_day
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
   GROUP BY user_pseudo_id),
  cohort_sizes AS
  (SELECT
     first_day,
     count() AS cohort_size
   FROM cohorts
   GROUP BY first_day)
SELECT
  a.event_date AS TIME,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 1) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs1.first_day = a.event_date - 1, cs1.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d1_retention,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 7) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs7.first_day = a.event_date - 7, cs7.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d7_retention,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 14) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs14.first_day = a.event_date - 14, cs14.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d14_retention
FROM analytics_events a
INNER JOIN cohorts c ON a.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs1 ON cs1.first_day = a.event_date - 1
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs7 ON cs7.first_day = a.event_date - 7
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs14 ON cs14.first_day = a.event_date - 14
WHERE a.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND a.event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND a.event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY a.event_date
ORDER BY a.event_date

WITH
  cohorts AS
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     min(event_date) AS first_day
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
   GROUP BY user_pseudo_id),
  cohort_sizes AS
  (SELECT
     first_day,
     count() AS cohort_size
   FROM cohorts
   GROUP BY first_day)
SELECT
  a.event_date AS observation_date,
  max(if(cs1.first_day = a.event_date - 1, cs1.cohort_size, NULL)) AS d1_cohort_size,
  uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 1) AS d1_retained,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 1) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs1.first_day = a.event_date - 1, cs1.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d1_pct,
  max(if(cs7.first_day = a.event_date - 7, cs7.cohort_size, NULL)) AS d7_cohort_size,
  uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 7) AS d7_retained,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 7) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs7.first_day = a.event_date - 7, cs7.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d7_pct,
  max(if(cs14.first_day = a.event_date - 14, cs14.cohort_size, NULL)) AS d14_cohort_size,
  uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 14) AS d14_retained,
  round(uniqExactIf(a.user_pseudo_id, c.first_day = a.event_date - 14) * 100.0 / nullIf(max(if(cs14.first_day = a.event_date - 14, cs14.cohort_size, 0)), 0), 1) AS d14_pct
FROM analytics_events a
INNER JOIN cohorts c ON a.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs1 ON cs1.first_day = a.event_date - 1
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs7 ON cs7.first_day = a.event_date - 7
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes cs14 ON cs14.first_day = a.event_date - 14
WHERE a.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND a.event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND a.event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY a.event_date
ORDER BY a.event_date DESC
